blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The lead defense lawyer of former President Rodrigo Duterte is opposing a prosecution witness whose testimony was deemed opinionated about the former leader’s role in the war on drugs. Peter Haynes expressed concern about a witness identified only as “P-1302,” who may be questioned and cross-examined for six hours despite offering his “personal opinions” on the accusations against Duterte. “[I]’ve flagged this up before, is that if the guardrails come off with P-1302, then we could have a trial in which everybody is advancing their personal opinions about this, that and the other, and Mr. Duterte’s character and the like,” […]...
